Name: Pie de Valley (A portrait mod for Stardew Valley)
Author: piedelune666
Description:
[b][size=5][center][u][i]☽ ✦ ENG﻿ ✦ ☾[/i][/u][/center]About the mod[/size][/b]
Pie de Valley is a mod that changes all of the portraits of the [size=1](current) [/size]NPC's in Stardew Valley to my artstyle. It is heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759?tab=description]Gigi[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DC Burger[/url]'s portraits, so please check them out!

[size=2]This was originally made for personal use, so it may diverge a bit from the original portraits. Other times, I made sure to follow the original portraits as faithfully as I could, just because I thought it would be funny. [/size][size=1](Check out Sam's eye color in his sprites and portraits!)
[/size]
[b][size=5]Download Instructions[/size][/b]
This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999?tab=description][b]Portraiture[/b][/url] to function.﻿
[b]After you've set up Portraiture[/b], download this mod and [b]place it on the 'Portraits' folder[/b], and you're probably good to go.
[b][i]Don't forget to click 'P' in a dialogue box to change between your downloaded portraits![/i][/b]

Hope you enjoy the mod, and let me know if anything breaks your game!

[size=5][b][i][u][center]☽ ✦ PT-BR ✦ ☾[/center][/u][/i][/b][/size][size=5][b]Sobre o mod

[size=2]Isto foi feito originalmente para uso pessoal, então pode divergir um pouco dos portraits originais. Por vezes, eu fiz questão de seguir os portraits originais o mais fielmente possível, só porque eu achei que seria funny. (Saca só a cor dos olhos de Sam em seus sprites e portraits!)

Espero que curtam o mod, e me avisem se algo quebrar seu jogo!
